humanAction: Opened Tagged note.md, put the cursor inside the tag #project/alpha on line 5, and opened the editor context menu. Tag Wrangler contributed six items across three sections.
notes: MEASURED GROUND TRUTH for this bundle (0.6.5-nl.2), first measured 2026-08-30 and re-confirmed 2026-09-09 against the running app; Task 22's acceptance test asserts these numbers. addCommand: 0 (confirmed live: the plugin registers no commands at all). file-menu registrations: 0. editor-menu registrations: 1 -- this is the entire harvestable surface. DOM-delegated listeners: 10, of which exactly 2 are contextmenu-typed; the other eight are pointerdown / drag / mouseover / click. All ten are structurally unreachable with no DOM and are recorded as HarvestedUnreachable { kind: "dom_delegated_menu" }. There is also a Menu.prototype patch for preview-mode tags, also unreachable. So the harvest recovers ONE menu hook and TEN unreachable entry points; the acceptance test asserts that pair, not a flattering total. onLayoutReady does four things, not one: getCachedFiles().forEach(path => getCache(path)?.frontmatter), then registerEvent(metadataCache.on("changed", ...)), then registerEvent(vault.on("delete", ...)), then workspace.getLeavesOfType("tag").forEach(leaf => leaf?.view?.requestUpdateTags?.()). The shim must survive all four: the last is the load-bearing case for getLeavesOfType returning [] and never undefined, and the two registerEvent calls make tag-wrangler a live subscriber to metadata changes for the rest of the session, not a one-shot scanner. The observed menu items are in expected/editor-menu.json; expected/ is otherwise byte-identical to vault/, because the menu registration mutates no files. The live capture also collected three items contributed by OTHER plugins loaded in the capture vault (advanced-canvas "New base", cmdr "Add command", meta-bind "Meta Bind"); those are recorded in editor-menu.json under otherPluginItems and are not part of the assertion. PARAMS RESPELLED FOR THE OP (Task 22): the capture recorded menu_id / active_file / cursor; host.list_menu_items takes { context, path } and has no cursor parameter at all, because the host builds an editor-menu subject of (a headless editor stub, { file }) rather than opening a buffer. The captured cursor position (line 5, ch 18, inside #project/alpha) therefore has no headless counterpart.
